title: Mechanistic Circuit Identification for Controllable Data Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While recent advances in data synthesis aim to curate high-quality datasets, most generation pipelines still rely on heuristic prompt-based control. This black-box paradigm provides limited insight into how individual samples interact with a model's underlying learning dynamics. To bridge this gap, we propose a circuit-grounded framework that connects training-dynamics-based data valuation with mechanistic interpretability (MI). Specifically, we conceptualize data quality along three complementary utility axes, learnability, challenge, and alignment. First, we uncover specialized model-internal circuits that causally govern these utility signals. Then, moving beyond heuristic prompting toward mechanistic control, we leverage these circuits as controllable interfaces, actively steering generation to produce utility-targeted data. translated_title: 面向可控数据生成的机制电路识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24065v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管近期数据合成方面的进展旨在策展高质量数据集，但大多数生成流程仍依赖于基于提示的启发式控制。这种黑箱范式对单个样本如何与模型底层学习动态相互作用提供的洞察有限。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种电路基础框架，将基于训练动态的数据估值与机制可解释性（MI）相结合。具体而言，我们将数据质量概念化为三个互补的效用轴：可学习性、挑战性和对齐性。首先，我们揭示出模型内部专门电路，这些电路因果地控制这些效用信号。然后，超越启发式提示转向机制控制，我们利用这些电路作为可控接口，主动引导生成以产出效用目标数据。基于此能力，我们引入了SAMS（阶段感知机制调度），该调度器调度电路...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于电路识别的框架，通过连接数据估值与机制可解释性，实现可控数据生成，并引入SAMS调度器以优化效用目标数据产出。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a circuit-grounded framework that connects data valuation with mechanistic interpretability for controllable data generation, introducing SAMS scheduling to produce utility-targeted data.
